narrative_note: Southbound across snitt 4 (between SE3 and SE4 — the southernmost snitt). The last reinforcement step here was tied to the SydVästlänken HVDC commissioning in 2021 (per NUP §4.6.1.3). Future reinvestments planned in southwest Sweden — Halland and Västra Götaland — drive maintenance more than capacity expansion.
